comparison.purpose: The model maps free-text commands onto a real app's machine events (ADD/TOGGLE/DELETE/NOTHING/QUIT), with an explicit doNothing escape hatch and guard-enforced honesty on nonexistent ids. Ships a with/without-machine A/B pair (index.ts vs imperative.ts) so the machine's typed events, guard rejection+retry, and resumable snapshot can be compared against a raw generateObject loop.
